title: Downtown Tampa Running Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Come see Tampa Bay the Healthy Way on our 4 mile casual jog around downtown Tampa and our award winning riverwalk! Runners will pass by a number of historic locations, murals, etc, including the Tampa Theatre, Tampa Postcard Mural, UT, Amalie Arena, Old City Hall and many more. Your tour guide will stop at 4 locations along the route to tell runners all about the history of the stop as well as allowing for photos and a little rest before the next mile/tour stop. Fun anecdotes, a few ghost stories, a few locals only stories and definitely advice on where to eat if you aren't local are also a part of the experience. On foot is always the best way to see a city - running just allows us to see more. So grab your running shoes and let's go see the best parts of downtown Tampa in just over an hour!
